description:
Returns RSI, MACD, Stochastics, ADX, moving averages, and pivot points
    for stocks and ETFs.

    Covers stocks and ETFs alike (e.g. 'NVDA', 'SPY', 'QQQ', 'VTI') with the
    same payload shape. For an ETF's analyst consensus, forecast, holdings or
    exposures, use get_etf_analysis, get_etf_forecast, get_etf_top_stocks, or
    get_etf_exposures.

    Args:
        tickers: Comma-separated stock or ETF tickers (e.g. 'NVDA' or 'NVDA,SPY').
        timeFrame: '1m','5m','15m','30m','1h','5h','day','3d','week','2w','month' (default: 'day')
            '5h' is slow upstream: request it for one ticker per call.

    Returns: summary scores, oscillators (RSI, MACD, Stochastics, ADX, CCI,
             Williams %R, ATR, ROC), moving averages, and pivot points.
             Labels are strings. indicator: "Buy", "Neutral" or "Sell" (null
             on ATR and pivot points). scoreScale: "StrongBuy", "Buy",
             "Neutral", "Sell" or "StongSell" (the upstream's own spelling).

timeFrame.description: One of '1m','5m','15m','30m','1h','5h','day','3d','week','2w','month' (default: 'day'). Request '5h' for one ticker per call.
timeFrame.title: Timeframe

name: get_technical_analysis
